# Independent discussion export receiving

The frozen authored fixture and CLI receiver accept the discussion export in PR91. The final receipt contains fourteen accepted cases: the prior successful full case is adopted from cli-cut2 without executing it again, and thirteen outstanding cases ran once after the original author suite and owned children ended. The continuation completed on 2026-10-08 at 20:41:48Z with exit 0 and empty stderr.

The fixture distinguishes numeric and string IDs, a deleted entry with retained raw fields, absent and empty readable bodies, media-only markup, ambiguous participants, duplicate entry IDs, a raw parent_id that conflicts with structural placement, an unmatched unread marker and a separate new-entry metadata stream. Full and unread downloads equal the complete unchanged normalized reader output. Requested IDs and local report creation time stay separate from that normalized payload.

The actual CLI uses an owned ephemeral loopback HTTP server and a synthetic token. It performs the expected read-only topic/view GETs with the unchanged client's `per_page=50` query. Unread and empty selections succeed; missing or ambiguous unread data, a malformed view, unavailable topic, and oversized normalized output refuse without a new report. Existing files, directories, symlinks and dangling symlinks remain unchanged before any GET. Missing-parent output fails without creating the parent; a competing destination created during the view read survives exclusive publication.

The source is frozen at renderer SHA256 95e8d7078462a60d4d3f1c4bd46b302bb69598563675f44d5d0326edf69d8cde and native CLI 11215a327e206cef6326c2cfa06feb8e68107dafda0aa835618d83dceac5563f. Reader, API, client, writer and both implementation files match before and after receiving. Source review confirms the deleted-is-True rule, normalized author/body use, source-order structural navigation, inert escaped source fields, visible counts/warnings, complete JSON serialization and bounded report refusal. The existing page_export writer's `cleanup_warning` is propagated; this receiver does not claim a new fault-injection qualification of that unchanged helper.

Earlier outcomes remain preserved. The first tiny checkpoint ended exit 1 and its requested files were absent; the tool returned no diagnostic establishing a cause. A pre-execution timestamp assertion was relaxed from a cosmetic Z suffix to an explicit timezone-bearing ISO timestamp. cli-cut1 stopped because the receiver incorrectly assumed an empty query; unchanged client source proved `per_page=50`. cli-cut2 accepted the full export and then killed/reaped an unread child after 30 seconds while the separate full author suite was running. The timeout's cause is not asserted. receiver-v4 raises the bounded child allowance to 120 seconds, records a timeout if one occurs, and reuses the accepted full artifact. None of these corrections changes production source.

The successful continuation is cli-cut3/receiving.json. The full artifact stays cli-cut2/full.html, SHA256 5255e430919e65eb33c4114a27e4bd7702e961c10c5e6d159ed58dc81465f084, with normalized JSON 0fb98cac015d190ff3a10eea7e3643c2d981234cc58bb7ffc8921e2d40d8d638. The unread artifact is cli-cut3/unread.html, SHA256 e65786ab57b0172ba87b9b3b6f9b1ffe54a86660e5fa35db586b5dcb65503e29, with normalized JSON bce517fa832eaa1fe8bf0fb911001b352c7832bdf9e4f22a028de38c35f74966.

Runtime's independent actual Chromium/print/download receiving is a separate packet; this CLI packet does not claim to execute a browser. Its full-only result was separately read and accepted without erasing the earlier unread timeout. The later unread browser outcome belongs to that receiver.

current-composition-review.json binds the source to the actual hosted-tested synthetic merge 17a368885b7c4d579ecd9b80dda5afe560091cf2 / tree 73c7373186df76e1b26be5a3c0a492889b61e938. All 1,581 unrelated current-target leaves are preserved. Removing our two CLI additions and one README addition restores target b6d73588887ce57a2637ab72ee424a5eb29e543f byte-for-byte. All nine new leaves equal source head 8548037fe4f6b9e1a640cdabdd288a0c3f8751b1. The unchanged native reader/API/client/writer/project manifest closure also matches that merge. This is source receiving, not a claim that the older native CLI file contains later peer commands.

Only synthetic discussion data is included. No live Canvas account, mark-read action, post, attachment fetch or external site was used. Equality concerns normalized JSON, not original HTTP byte formatting or cache freshness. Boundary and nonfinite renderer tests and hosted whole-project checks are recorded by their respective owners; they were not redundantly rerun here. Symlink fixtures are described by the receiver and omitted from file payloads.

The publication bundle contains only UTF-8 files under this owned receiver root, excluding its own publication directory. The manifest pins every included byte; no browser profiles, caches, executables or peer files are included.
